fields.description: Neila is an Al Furjan development focused on studios and one-bedroom apartments. Its compact homes sit around shared social and leisure spaces, with pools, a gym and outdoor seating. The first-floor plans also illustrate why a large terrace can make two homes with the same bedroom count very different in usable interior space.
